verdict.rationale: Deel documents a public REST API at api.letsdeel.com, with concrete endpoints such as POST /rest/contracts. The docs also cover API-token and OAuth2 authentication, header-based date versioning, and an isolated sandbox with pre-populated data. The docs are agent-friendly, with llms.txt and .md versions of pages, and an MCP server maps tools directly onto the API operations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented in practice.
